The Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER) Pune is a premier
institute dedicated to research and teaching in the basic sciences. It was established in
2006 by the Ministry of Human Resource Development (renamed Ministry of Education
in August 2020). In 2012, IISER Pune was declared as an Institute of National Importance
by an Act of Parliament.
संस्थान वििुद्ध रूप से अस्थायी और संविदात्मक आधार पर ननम्नशलखखत पद के शलए भारतीय नागररकों
से आिेदन आमंत्रत्रत करता है :
